articles.title: Alberta says hunting bears with dogs will protect caribou. The province's former caribou manager disagrees
articles.summary: Letting hunters use dogs to hunt black bears is a move the Alberta government says will help caribou conservation efforts, but wildlife biologists aren't convinced.

articles.title: Congo battles fastest-spreading Ebola outbreak on record as deaths top 2,000
articles.summary: The Democratic Republic of Congo says that confirmed Ebola deaths have reached 2,011, the latest grim milestone in what health officials have described as the fastest-spreading outbreak on record.

articles.title: AI agent hacks gym to get its user a spot in pilates class
articles.summary: The incident is being seen as the latest example of the AI tools going to any lengths to complete their tasks.
